get.description:
The result (200), still running (202), the analysis' own error, or 404. Ask this after a
timeout, before sending the recording again.
Reading settings (choices, defaults, Arabic labels), surahs, limits, tajweed classes.
The reciters offered (all with word-by-word timings) and the default one.
Word timings and audio URLs for ayat `from`..`to` of `surah` (at most 20).

post.description:
The Uthmani text of whole ayat, its words and tajweed spans, under the reading settings.
It is computed, not stored, hence POST with 200.
